notes: AI-assisted manual review (optional, self-configured endpoint/model/key stored locally). Offline by default; the opt-in version check is read-only, multi-source and never uploads table data. Downloaded bytes must embed TOOL_VERSION >= the announced latest. Version check and download retry silently up to 3 times when every source fails. New in 1.3.6: AI settings and Feedback moved to the top-right corner; the Feedback panel is now a short guidance card pointing to the public GitHub issues page plus a contact email. External links open only when the user clicks them. The local feedback draft from 1.3.5 was removed. Also keeps the GitHub Contents API download fallback from 1.3.4. Final answers are always chosen by the native-speaker human reviewer.
